answer.note: The incoming handoff chose B and C, which I changed to D and C. All four ref files contain the same generic text, so they gave me no way to choose. I decided from the code. The only match is `_verify_history` in dogwhistle/honest.py (D), lines 175-195. It raises if prereg_commit equals ledger_commit ("ledger seal must be a separate commit"). It also requires `git diff --name-only` between the two commits to list only the public digest file. I did not run any code or tests, so this is from reading only. The two-arm part of the request is unconfirmed. I did not check that honest.py is a two-arm design, and I did not read the test files. Suggested 60 minutes: honest.py 35, visibility.py (C) 12, study.py (A) 7, heldout.py (B) 6. visibility.py has a near-identical `_verify_history` (line 191) with neither the equal-commit check nor the changed-files check, so it is the closest sibling to compare. study.py and heldout.py have a three-commit `verify_history` that checks ancestry and anchors but not equality or changed files. A reviewer who wants to test the two-arm claim could also check tests/test_honest.py.
